interpretation: These are reviewed source-ID constraints and acceptable witnesses, not exhaustive gold groupings. Unlisted alternatives require human review. Runtime scores do not establish human quality. c114 belongs only to final editing.

items.reason: Do not split of / one-half or of / one. gain / in is preferred for reserve/rhythm; worth / of remains an acceptable alternative, not sole gold.

Keep the antecedent with this short restrictive clause; do not mix its orphan tail with And there are... . The reference four-screen grouping is an acceptable witness, not a universal ban on long relative-clause splitting.

Known frequency-attachment issue: do not treat value / a few times as an unconditionally ideal clause boundary. The independent three-screen grouping is acceptable; semantics of other variants need review.

so belongs with its result, not hanging at the preceding cue end. User explicitly allowed c70 for / where at the observed pause; do not hard-protect every preposition-plus-clause or require a change here. No claim that the pause was acoustically classified.
Keep and then with the restarted statement rather than the end of the preceding statement. Do not remove or rewrite the oral restart in source chunking.
Known short ability + infinitival-complement split is undesirable. Long complements are not universally hard-protected; primary / criterion long pause is not proof of a good semantic boundary.
User allowed this final-editor merge with its explicit length warning. It is not a requirement that the source DP produce an over-capacity cue and must not be counted as a source-DP failure.
